content.section_title: 5.2 Pharmacological treatments for patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
content.summary: Pharmacotherapy is the cornerstone of treatment for HFrEF and should be implemented before device therapy, alongside non-pharmacological interventions. Three major goals: (i) reduction in mortality, (ii) prevention of recurrent hospitalizations due to worsening HF, and (iii) improvement in clinical status, functional capacity, and quality of life.
goals: Prevention of recurrent hospitalizations due to worsening heart failure
Improvement in clinical status, functional capacity, and quality of life
